title: Security Guide
description: Comprehensive guide to Kahana's security features and best practices
content:
Security Guide

Learn about Kahana's security features and how to implement security best practices for your organization.

Key Security Features

Access Control

Implement role-based access control and multi-factor authentication to secure your workspace.

Data Protection

End-to-end encryption and secure data storage protect your sensitive information.

Security Best Practices

  • Enable two-factor authentication for all users
  • Regularly review access permissions
  • Keep security settings up to date
  • Monitor security logs regularly
